description:
Weaving DNA from the past with modern BMX technology, the 40th Anniversary Haro Freestyler is an early 80s dream living in the present. Masterfully created to retain its original look, with right now features like an hourglass mid BB and integrated head tube that maintains the classic cup look, but stays tight and spins smoothly. Forks are made of fully heat-treated and butted chromoly tubing, as are the lineage bars. Genuine Oakley B1-B grips sit next to Dia-Compe Tech 77 levers. The cranks take flight with 3-piece tubular chromoly construction with a 48 spline/19mm spindle. The BOB cross alloy sprocket looks the part and puts the Lineage wheels in motion. Front and rear Dia-Compe Hombre brakes keep it all under control. The legend rolls on...
100% chromoly Lineage Freestyler frame with twin top tube, Mid BB shell, integrated head tube and Lineage cast dropouts with integrated chain tensioners
100% heat treated chromoly Lineage fork with CNC threaded steer tube, investment cast drop-outs and 990 brake mounts with internal brake cable routing
100% heat treated and butted chromoly Lineage bars 8.5" with Haro Lineage CNC alloy top load stem
Lineage heat treated 3-piece alloy 165mm cranks with Bob Haro Lineage 28T CNC alloy bolt drive sprocket and sealed Mid BB
Fully sealed 36H wheels with Lineage high flange hubs and double-wall hi polished alloy rims
Haro Snakebite tires 20 x 2.125" front and rear
Haro Lineage padded stealth Pivotal seat with alloy Lineage Pivotal fluted post
Oakley B1B Grips, just like Bob Haro rode in 1982

components.description: Sealed mid BB.
Dia-Compe FS996 Hombre U-brake; cold forged aluminum arms; dual spring tension adjustment w/anchor bolt parts
Dia-Compe Tech-77 levers, right and left side. Cold-forged aluminum lever with hinged clamp.
KMC K1SL Narrow Silver Super Lite 1/8" width.
Haro BOB Lineage "cross" sprocket; CNC bolt drive sprocket; 5mm thick. 28T.
Haro Fusion cranks (bolt drive interface). 165mm; 19mm 48-spline spindle; heat treated 4130 chromoly. RSD/LSD compatible.
Teflon bearing Gyro. CNC-machined 6061 aluminum.
Haro Lineage Freestyler full chromoly fork with welded 990 mounts and internal cable routing. Tapered legs. Invest cast 3/8" dropouts. 33mm offset.
Oakley B1B grip. 145mm length x 29mm diameter. 50mm OD flange.
Lineage bar. 8.5" rise. 100% heat treated, multi-butted chromoly.
Sealed Integrated, 1 1/8".
Lineage high flange 36h alloy hub body. Sealed bearings. 3/8" chromoly male axle. Chrome plated hardware.
Lineage high flange hub alloy hub body. Sealed 9T cassette driver. 14mm chromoly male axle. Chrome plated hardware.
Haro Fusion "DX" style. Alloy bodies. Steel pins. Chromoly axle.
6061 alloy pegs. 34mm OD. 110mm length. Four (4) included.
Lineage 36h alloy rims. Double-wall. Welded seams.
Haro Lineage Slim stealth pivotal seat.
Haro stealth pivotal seat post; 25.4 x 300mm.
Dia-Compe MX hinged clamp. 6061 alloy.
14 gauge stainless steel. 12mm alloy nipples. 3 cross lace pattern.
Haro Lineage top load stem; T6 alloy; cold forged with CNC detail. 45mm reach.
Snakebite 20 x 2.125" front and rear. 60 max PSI.
